=== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of the dark-haired adult with sunglasses in a Facebook photograph posted 11 January 2022. Exact legal name already on the wiki plus membership in the Star Wars CCG Facebook group (facebook.com/jon.vandermeer.94). The uncropped original is a color-run family photograph used as the profile circular. That adult is the more central face in the circular. He is holding the toddler with the woman on the left. Lives San Antonio, Texas; Rogue 2 FL San Antonio. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Jon VanDerMeer portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Jon VanDerMeer Facebook portrait.jpg]].
